moduleInfo.moduleDesc: MangaDex module (advanced search with highest/lowest community rating sorting).
moduleInfo.changelog: v4.7.6: Adds sort:highest rating and sort:lowest rating. Rating sorts use a separate MangaDex statistics lookup for the already-filtered results; unrated titles stay at the end. Normal search, tags, content ratings, and date sorts are unchanged.
